title: Sticks don't wake it
line: Stops a nudge of the sticks from waking the handheld while it goes to sleep.
symptom: The built-in controller (0b05:1b4c) is a wakeup source, so stick movement wakes the device before or during sleep.
why: The ASUS controller 0b05:1b4c shared by the Ally X, Xbox Ally, Xbox Ally X and Xbox Ally X20 (InputPlumber configs); the first Ally's 0b05:1abe isn't a wakeup source.
risk_note: One udev rule, the same one Bazzite ships. The power button still wakes it.

changes.detail: Switches off wake-up for the built-in controller (USB 0b05:1b4c).
Set to disabled at once; the old value is saved.

undo: Deletes the rule and writes the saved value back.
steamos: Unknown; the fix checks the system's own rules.

probe.what: Looks for the same rule from the system itself (any udev rule that isn't GameCove's and does the same), or the value already being right without GameCove.

watch.note: The Ally's kernel HID driver: it could switch the wake-up off itself.
